message.openblocks_reborn.book.catalog_w:
OpenBlocks Reborn Guide

This catalog contains all %s registered items. Entries are grouped into machines, world blocks, equipment, tools, components, and fluids. It also documents the three OpenBlocks enchantments.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.enchantme: Flim Flam (I–IV) works on weapons and armor in player combat. Weapon level contests one third of the defender's combined armor levels, rounded down. The weaker side accumulates bad luck; equal levels add none. Strong armor can turn a prank back on the attacker. This is not a vanilla curse that constantly penalizes its wearer. The master switch defaults on, but all six prank options default off: shuffle hotbar, launch upwards, nausea, slowness, rename held item and random teleport. With none selected, no luck penalties, prank sounds or messages occur. With effects selected, sufficient bad luck gives a one-in-four check each second, followed by a 15-second cooldown after a prank. All three enchantments default to non-treasure and can appear at the enchanting table. Each treasure setting is configurable; treasure mode excludes the table while retaining trades and applicable random-loot paths.

Unstable (I–III) goes on armor. Boots consume gunpowder when falling more than four blocks without sneaking, canceling the fall and launching their wearer in an explosion. Enchanted helmets, chestplates and leggings also explode when an entity hurts the wearer. Levels I/II/III consume 1/2/4 gunpowder and damage the triggering armor. Base explosion powers are 2/3/4; TNT has power 4. The configurable multiplier ranges from 0.25 to 2, with final power bounded to 0.5–8. The effect defaults on, multiplier 1, with terrain destruction off. Enabling terrain damage permits only level III to destroy blocks. Nearby entities can still be hurt.

Last Stand (I–II) goes on armor. When damage actually kills a player, vanilla totems get the first chance to save them. Only if no totem saved the player does Last Stand attempt to spend XP and restore one health point. Nonlethal hits never trigger it, and absorption is processed first. All damage sources, including void and commands, are eligible, but insufficient XP means no rescue and no partial charge. Costs use XP points rather than levels: ceil(50 * (1 - projected health after damage) / combined armor enchantment levels * configured multiplier), minimum one point. Very large hits can be very expensive. The effect defaults on, with multiplier 1 (range 0.1–10). Cooldown defaults to zero, with a range of 0–600 seconds. Only a successful Last Stand rescue starts its cooldown; totems and failed attempts do not.
Machines
Blocks that process items or fluids, automate a task, or expose configurable input and output sides.
Place it in the world. Use it to open its controls; supply items, fluids, experience, or redstone as appropriate.
World Blocks
Construction, transport, utility, decoration, and interaction blocks used directly in the world.
Place this block in the world. Its special interaction is available by using, standing on, powering, or connecting it.
Wearable Equipment
Items worn in an equipment slot or used while moving, sleeping, or gliding.
Equip this item in its appropriate armor slot or hold it while using its movement or resting ability.
Tools and Devices
Handheld tools for painting, inspection, linking, remote control, storage, and world interaction.
Use this item in hand. Sneak-use commonly selects a mode or opens configuration; its tooltip shows stored state.
Components and Materials
Crafting parts, legacy migration items, and consumable materials.
This is primarily a crafting component or compatibility item rather than a standalone machine.
Fluids
Containers used to move OpenBlocks fluids between the world and compatible machines.
Use it like a vanilla bucket: empty it into compatible tanks or the world and collect the fluid with an empty bucket.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.cr: Equip the Crane Backpack. Hold use to retract/raise, hold sneak-use to extend/lower, and left-click to grab or release. While held, the controller suppresses attacking, mining, and right-click interaction with targeted blocks or entities.
A chest-slot Crane assembly. Pair it with the Crane Control to operate its rendered arm, cable, and magnetic head.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.go: Sneak-use to search for a structure by name or ID. Locating runs on a dedicated background thread and binds when complete. Normal use points toward it, consuming durability without throwing the eye.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.im: Placed by Magic Pencils or Crayons. Only matching drawing tools reveal, select, and reshape these imaginary blocks.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.in: The OpenBlocks guide now uses Patchouli for categories, instructions and recipes. Pages marked 1.12.2 reference preserve historical descriptions; use each entry's current instructions and limits.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.book.landing: OpenBlocks is an open source mod that introduces a variety of ideas into Minecraft, including hang gliders, elevators, tanks, graves, paints, cranes, liquid XP, cartographers, trophies and more!
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.la: An emerald trapdoor with vanilla-style opening and closing. Its open panel can also be climbed like a ladder.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.gu: Projects while powered. Side buttons adjust or copy six half-axes; top buttons rotate and select 11 shapes, and dyes recolor it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.bu: The powered Builder Guide places the next projected block per use. In creative, obsidian above it enables full-shape replacement.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.he: Periodically restores health and a small amount of hunger and saturation to players standing on it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ta: Raises while powered. Projectile hits output a temporary redstone strength from 1 to 15 based on accuracy.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.gr: Stores up to 54 slots of a player's death drops. The owner can use the grave to recover all stored items.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.fl: A non-solid decorative flag that can stand on floors or hang on walls. Use dyes to recolor it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ta: Stores 16 B of fluid. Adjacent tanks connect and balance their contents, and vanilla buckets fill or drain them directly.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.tr: Displays a chosen mob trophy. Set its mob with a spawn egg, then use it empty-handed to play that mob's sound.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.be: Snaps shut on creatures, damaging and immobilizing them while emitting redstone. Use or power it to reset.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sp: Stores 1 B of water, applies water-like effects above it, and encourages crop growth. Bone meal boosts growth.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ca: Fires items from a 3x3 inventory on redstone. It shoots forward by default, or at a target bound with a Pointer.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.va: Collects nearby items and XP orbs into an inventory and 4 B XP tank. Its item and fluid output sides are configurable.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sp: Removes nearby fluid blocks when placed or used. It can be triggered repeatedly without becoming a wet sponge.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.bi: A stone oversized button. The total count in its eight slots sets its pulse duration from 1 to 512 ticks.
A wooden oversized button that arrows can trigger. Its eight-slot item count sets a 1 to 512 tick pulse.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.fa: Continuously pushes entities away from its front while powered. It supports horizontal, upward, and downward facing.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.xp: Combines glass bottles with liquid XP to make Bottles o' Enchanting, with configurable automatic item and fluid I/O.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.vi: Whose bed or workstation is this? Use the highlighter, then aim at a nearby bed, workstation or bell. Single live mode shows one actual linked villager and its home, job and meeting links. Blue marks beds, orange workstations and gold bells. All snapshots require a button click, remain visible for 10 seconds, and have a 10-second cooldown. They never refresh automatically. Villager positions stay fixed in each snapshot, with at most 16 villagers; a warning indicates sampling or display limits. Yellow boxes enclose a villager's iron-golem search volume, not guaranteed spawn positions. The optional blue village boundary uses modern POI classification, clipped to loaded sampled sections, rather than the old sphere. Queries never load distant terrain.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pa: A very thin, non-colliding road laid on a solid top face. It drops itself if its supporting block is removed.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.au: Automates vanilla anvil repairing, combining, enchantment merging, and renaming with liquid XP and configurable I/O.
Automatically enchants with lapis and liquid XP. Its slider follows bookshelf power and modded enchantment limits.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.xp: Absorbs XP orbs and XP from players standing above it. It stores 1 B of liquid XP and outputs through its bottom.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.bl: Breaks the block in front on a redstone rising edge. Drops enter a container behind it, with overflow dropped nearby.
Places a block from its inventory directly in front when triggered. It supports horizontal, upward, and downward facing.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.it: Ejects stored items in any of six directions. Its UI controls speed and whether redstone strength scales the amount.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ro: Attaches to the clicked block face and consumes more ladders to extend downward. The hanging chain is climbable.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.do: A one-slot donation box for accepting and displaying contributed items in shared or public areas.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pa: Mixes a chosen RGB color from cyan, magenta, yellow, and black dyes, coloring brushes or paint cans after 300 ticks.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ca: Provides a 16x16 pixel grid on every face. Large tools affect a face, small tools affect one pixel, and stencils add patterns.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pa: Stores a custom RGB paint color. Brushes can sample it, and a Paint Mixer can recolor it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ca: A transparent Canvas with the same six 16x16 faces, large and small painting tools, and stencil support.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pr: Projects a 9x9 terrain shape from a Height Map. It can capture an Empty Height Map in place and rotate the projection.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.dr: Processes blank or existing stencils into a selected pattern, or outputs a selected Glyph using its page controls.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sk: Renders as the local sky while active but stays solid. Redstone controls it, and use toggles normal or inverted activation.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.xp: Stores 1 B of liquid XP and pulls it from the rear. While powered, it releases XP orbs beneath itself.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.go: Records its owner and hatches their sole Mini Me after about 30 seconds; another hatch replaces the old one. The owner can use it to toggle follow/stay, and the pair split either one's final damage and healing equally. Redstone quadruples hatching speed.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ha: Use while held to deploy. It slows falling and holds the player horizontally beneath the wing with a subtle limb sway; sneak descends faster and flight consumes durability.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ge: A stackable generic item retained for legacy world and recipe compatibility. It currently has no direct active use.
An unstackable generic item retained for legacy world and recipe compatibility. It currently has no direct active use.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.lu: Deploys owner-following Luggage with 27 slots that collects nearby drops. Sneak-use it to pack it with contents preserved.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.so: Wear to see positional sounds as fading icons with subtitles and distance, even through walls. Silent mobs are not highlighted. Modern sculk, Warden, Allay, amethyst, copper and wind sounds have categories. Only received sounds are shown; music, UI and muted categories are excluded.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pe: Wear these to reveal and select imaginary blocks placed by the Magic Pencil so their shapes can be edited.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.cr: Wear these to reveal and select imaginary blocks matching the glasses' crayon color.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.te: Reveals every color of imaginary block while worn, without making all of them solid.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.se: Makes every imaginary block visible, selectable, and solid while worn, regardless of pencil or crayon color.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sl: Use it to test whether the current chunk is a slime chunk. Each test reports the result and consumes one durability.
Sleep in place at night without placing a block or changing your spawn point. Each use consumes durability.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pa: Loads color from an offhand dye or paint can. Use paints the aimed Canvas face; sneak-use paints every face.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sm: A pixel brush loaded from an offhand dye or paint can. It changes only the single Canvas pixel under the crosshair.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.st: Attach a Drawing Table pattern to a Canvas, then paint through it. Empty-hand use rotates it; sneak-use removes it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sq: Use removes paint from the aimed Canvas face; sneak-use clears every face. It also resets dyeable blocks to white.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sm: A pixel squeegee that removes only the single Canvas pixel under the crosshair.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.he: Stores surface heights for a 9x9 area. Use it to read the center terrain and biome, or insert it into a Projector.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.em: An uncaptured Height Map. A Cartographer or Projector can record a 9x9 terrain sample into it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ca: Use while holding an Empty Height Map in the other hand to capture a 9x9 terrain sample at your position.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ta: An edible clay snack that restores a small amount of hunger and saturation.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.cu: Sneak-use a block face to bind it, then use it at any distance or across dimensions. Distance XP cost is capped at 1,024 blocks; unloaded targets are reported, not force-loaded.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.de: Configure it from the offhand to absorb matching pickups and void overflow. Sneak-use returns the stored stack.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sp: Use it on a block to drain nearby fluids. Durability is consumed only when fluid was actually removed.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pe: Use it to report your total walking distance from player statistics, measured in blocks or meters.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ep: Removes lore from the offhand item. In the world it erases imaginary blocks or resets dyeable blocks to white.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.wr: Rotates supported facing or axis properties 90 degrees around the clicked face. Sneak-use buttons, levers, and chests; it rotates Guides.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.gl: Stores a selectable character. Use and sneak-use cycle it in opposite directions; use on a block hangs the glyph on its face.
A dedicated Hang Glider crafting component. Two wings are required for the completed glider.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.be: A structural Crane Backpack crafting component used to form its visible boom.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.cr: The Crane Backpack's engine component, assembled with its magnet, beams, and line.
A magnetic crafting component used by both the Crane Backpack and Miracle Magnet.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.mi: Attracts dropped items and XP orbs within eight blocks while in your inventory. Use it to toggle the effect.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.li: A Crane Backpack cable component used between its boom and magnetic head.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ma: A control component combined with Map Memory to craft an Empty Height Map.
A storage component combined with a Map Controller to craft an Empty Height Map.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.as: The core base component used to craft the handheld Cartographer.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.un: A blank stencil stock. Process it in a Drawing Table to select a pattern that can be attached to Canvas.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sk: A dedicated crafting component used to make the Drawing Table.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.po: Use it first on a Cannon, then on a target block in the same dimension to bind aimed deliveries.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.xp: A bucket containing 1 B of liquid XP with vanilla bucket priority. It fills XP machines or tanks and can place the fluid.

patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.beam: A structural Crane Backpack crafting component used to form its visible boom.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.cran: The Crane Backpack's engine component, assembled with its magnet, beams, and line.
A magnetic crafting component used by both the Crane Backpack and Miracle Magnet.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.mira: Attracts dropped items and XP orbs within eight blocks while in your inventory. Use it to toggle the effect.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.line: A Crane Backpack cable component used between its boom and magnetic head.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.map_: A control component combined with Map Memory to craft an Empty Height Map.
A storage component combined with a Map Controller to craft an Empty Height Map.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.assi: The core base component used to craft the handheld Cartographer.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.unpr: A blank stencil stock. Process it in a Drawing Table to select a pattern that can be attached to Canvas.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.sket: A dedicated crafting component used to make the Drawing Table.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.poin: Use it first on a Cannon, then on a target block in the same dimension to bind aimed deliveries.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.xp_b: A bucket containing 1 B of liquid XP with vanilla bucket priority. It fills XP machines or tanks and can place the fluid.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.title: 1.12.2 reference
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.notic: From the 1.12.2 manual, for historical context. Follow this entry's current instructions and limits.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.ladde: The jaded ladder solves that annoying problem of jumping out of a trapdoor at the top of a ladder. The jaded ladder acts as both a trap door and a ladder at the same time.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.guide:
The building guide, once powered with redstone, will give you an outline of ghost blocks in different shapes and sizes that'll help you plan out rooms.
Use touch-buttons on block to change outline dimensions and shapes.
Color of markers can be changed by using dye on central block.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.build: This enhanced version of building guide not only displays ghost blocks to make building easier, but also allows you to place actual blocks. Just click central block

with any block stack!
When in creative mode you can place an obsidian block above, then hit the building guide with any block you like to automatically create the
The healing block is a creative-mode only block that gives off a slight healing effect over time.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.targe: The target will give out a redstone signal of a strength relative to the accuracy of the player's aim. Give the target a redstone signal to make it pop up!
Flags can be used for decoration or for marking the way back out of a cave you've ventured in to. The flag will point in the direction that you placed it, or you can put it on walls. If you shift-click with a flag in your hand it will change color.
Tanks can hold liquids. If you place tanks next to each other and they'll distribute their liquid between the tanks. You can place liquid into the tanks using
buckets. If the tank contains XP Juice you can click on them with an empty hand to give yourself some of the XP. When broken tanks will retain their liquid.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.beart: Place a bear trap and click on it to open it up. When a mob walks over the trap they'll be unable to move!
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.sprin:
The sprinkler will help fertilize crops up to 4 blocks away. Simply place it above an OpenBlocks tank filled with water! You can also add bonemeal for an even faster rate of growth.
It also acts as a water source block!
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.canno: When given a redstone signal, the item cannon will shoot items that it finds in an adjacent inventory. Use the 'pointer' item to aim the cannon.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.vacuu: The vacuum hopper will suck up items and XP orbs around it. You can use the tabs on the right of the interface to select which sides to output to.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.spong: The sponge is a replacement for the vanilla sponge. Perfect for removing small pockets of lava or water. Be careful when using it on large areas of liquid though as it'll start to get quite messy.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.big_b: The big button is a large button that can be placed on walls. If you shift-click on the button with an empty hand it will bring up an inventory. You can put items in there to increase the length of time the button is pressed - one item increases the button press by one tick.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.fan.0: The fan will blow players, mobs or entities in the direction it's facing.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.xp_bo: The XP bottler will take XP juice and bottle it up into glass bottles to create bottles o' enchanting.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.villa: Drop the village highlighter down in a village and give it a redstone signal. It will outline the perimeter of the village and draw a box in the iron golem spawning area. Useful if you want to make sure villages don't merge into each other or you're making an iron farm!
The path doesn't do anything. It just looks nice!
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.auto_:
The auto anvil works just like the vanilla anvil, except it runs from XP juice and can be fully automated.

Use the tabs on the right of the GUI to select
which sides of the anvil items or liquid can be inserted or extracted. Right click and drag the anvil in the tab to spin it around and select other sides!

The auto enchantment table works in a similar way to the vanilla enchantment table except it runs off XP juice. Use the tabs on the right side of the interface to select where items or xp can be pulled from. Just like with the vanilla table bookshelves are required for higher levels.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.xp_dr: Place the XP drain above an OpenBlocks tank and stand on it. Your XP will drain into the tank, which can then be used for blocks such as the auto enchantment table or the auto anvil.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.block: When given a redstone pulse the block breaker will break the block it's facing.
When given a redstone pulse the block placer will place an item in the direction it's facing.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.item_: The item dropper is similar to the vanilla dropper, except it drops items without any random bias. User can also control speed of dropped item from GUI and with redstone power.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.rope_: When you place a rope ladder it'll roll out all the way to the ground. For every created ladder block it will use one item from stack.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.donat: Love a block or item and want to show the mod developer some appreciation? Drop it into the donation station and if we know the authors donation page we'll give you a link.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.paint: The paint mixer can mix any colour of paint you want! Drop either an existing paint bucket or a bucket of milk into the top slot, then cyan, magenta, yellow and black dyes into the other four slots and click mix!
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.canva: The canvas is a perfectly white block that's perfect for painting. See the Paint Mixer for information about making paints.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.proje: I'll let you write this one boq!
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.drawi: The drawing table is for creating stencils which can be used while painting. Insert an Unprepared Stencil into the drawing table then use the arrows to select which stencil you want!
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.xp_sh: Attach an XP shower to a tank of XP juice and it'll pour out XP orbs. These orbs can be collected by an XP Drain or an MFR Sewer.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.hang_:
The hang glider is self explanatory. Hold it in your hand and click to place it on your back. Now jump!
To increase your speed you can press shift while gliding, but watch out, you'll

lose altitude faster!

Your hang glider now also includes an acoustic variometer indicating vertical air movement. Press V to activate it and stay up forever (or until the sun goes
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.lugga:
Luggage is your new friend. He'll follow you around anywhere you go collecting any items he finds on the floor. Nom nom nom!
To dismantle him just shift-click on him and he'll turn into an item that you can carry around.
If he ever gets struck by lightning he'll be able to carry even more items!
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.sonic:
Introducing the fantabulous new Sonic Glasses!
This new and exciting technology from OpenMods Inc allow you see what you hear!
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.crane:
This hi-tech wireless remote is used for controlling magnet backpacks.

Right click to raise, Sneak + right click to lower, left click to pick/release.
Blinking light signals something is under magnet.

In Minecraft world "magnet" is ancient word for "how do this works?".

This particular piece of very equipment allows you to pick and carry mobs, players, items and blocks. Can be controlled with magnet control.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.slima: Walk around with the slimalyzer in your hand and it'll light up whenever you're in a slime spawning chunk.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.sleep: The sleeping bag lets you sleep out in the wilderness without having to reset your spawn location. To sleep, simply wear it on your back.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.paint:
Paint brushes let you paint blocks in whatever color you like!

Dab your paint brush in a Paint Can made in the Paint Mixer then click on a block to paint it.

Canvas blocks are
perfect for painting, but you can also paint quite a few vanilla blocks and even some blocks from other mods. You can also place stencils on blocks and then paint over the
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.squee: The squeegee removes paint from any painted blocks. Just click on the side of the block you want to remove the paint from, or alternative shift-click the block to remove paint from all sides!
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.curso:
The cursor will let you click on blocks remotely.
Simply shift-click onto a block to link the cursor, then use the cursor wherever you like to click on the target block. Be warned, by default the cursor uses up your XP relative to how far you are from the block you're clicking.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.dev_n: Click using /dev/null to open the inventory. There's a single inventory slot - put an item in there - dirt, for example. As you gather dirt from the ground this slot will
fill up. Once it's full, any more dirt you pick up will be automatically discarded. You can shift-click with the item in your hand as though you were placing the block!
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.spong: The sponge on a stick is a tool for cleaning up liquids. Works just like the sponge, but is more mobile at the expense of wearing out.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.epic_:
Every item has its own history...

Don't you hate it?
With this item you can scrub all traces of epic lore your loot has collected over the years and then sell it on black market without worrying about evidence.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.wrenc:
This is extremely sophisticated tool used to perform transformations of objects with octahedral symmetry.


Or just big, dumb piece of metal you can use to rotate cubes and stuff.

So yeah, it's yet another wrench. I'm just trying to be original here, ok?
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.legacy.unpre:
Stencils can be placed onto blocks and then painted over using paint brushes!

You can paint a block using multiple stencils and you can click on them with an empty hand to rotate them.

Place an Unprepared Stencil in a Drawing table to create different patterns.

highlighter.openblocks_reborn.title: Village Highlighter
highlighter.openblocks_reborn.request_hi: Use the highlighter and request a snapshot; no automatic refresh
highlighter.openblocks_reborn.aim: Aim at a bed, workstation or bell in scan range
highlighter.openblocks_reborn.empty: No loaded POIs found in scan range
highlighter.openblocks_reborn.owners: Found %s linked villagers in loaded scan area
highlighter.openblocks_reborn.no_owner: No linked villagers found in loaded scan area
highlighter.openblocks_reborn.search_onl: Yellow: golem search volume, not guaranteed spawn positions
highlighter.openblocks_reborn.limited: Sampling/display limit reached (16 snapshot villagers); inspect in Single mode
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.current.vill: snapshots require a button click, remain visible for 10 seconds, and have a 10-second cooldown. They never refresh automatically. Villager positions stay fixed in each snapshot, with at most 16 villagers; a warning indicates sampling or display limits.

Yellow boxes enclose a villager's iron-golem search volume, not guaranteed spawn positions. The optional blue village boundary uses modern POI classification, clipped to loaded sampled sections, rather than the old sphere. Queries never load distant
enchantment.openblocks_reborn.last_stand: After totems fail, spends sufficient XP to survive lethal damage.
enchantment.openblocks_reborn.unstable.d: Consumes gunpowder to explode; boots also launch on falls. No terrain damage by default.
PvP pranks and counterplay. Each prank is disabled by default.
tooltip.openblocks_reborn.enchantment_di: No effects of this enchantment are currently enabled
Flim Flam (I–IV) works on weapons and armor in player combat. Weapon level contests one third of the defender's combined armor levels, rounded down. The weaker side accumulates bad luck; equal levels add none. Strong armor can

turn a prank back on the attacker. This is not a vanilla curse that constantly penalizes its wearer. The master switch defaults on, but all six prank options default off: shuffle hotbar, launch upwards, nausea, slowness,

rename held item and random teleport. With none selected, no luck penalties, prank sounds or messages occur. With effects selected, sufficient bad luck gives a one-in-four check each second, followed by a 15-second cooldown

after a prank. All three enchantments default to non-treasure and can appear at the enchanting table. Each treasure setting is configurable; treasure mode excludes the table while retaining trades and applicable random-loot

Unstable (I–III) goes on armor. Boots consume gunpowder when falling more than four blocks without sneaking, canceling the fall and launching their wearer in an explosion. Enchanted helmets, chestplates and

leggings also explode when an entity hurts the wearer. Levels I/II/III consume 1/2/4 gunpowder and damage the triggering armor. Base explosion powers are 2/3/4; TNT has power 4. The configurable multiplier ranges

from 0.25 to 2, with final power bounded to 0.5–8. The effect defaults on, multiplier 1, with terrain destruction off. Enabling terrain damage permits only level III to destroy blocks. Nearby entities can still be

Last Stand (I–II) goes on armor. When damage actually kills a player, vanilla totems get the first chance to save them. Only if no totem saved the player does Last Stand attempt to spend XP and restore one health point. Nonlethal hits never trigger it, and absorption is

processed first. All damage sources, including void and commands, are eligible, but insufficient XP means no rescue and no partial charge. Costs use XP points rather than levels: ceil(50 * (1 - projected health after damage) / combined armor enchantment levels * configured

multiplier), minimum one point. Very large hits can be very expensive. The effect defaults on, with multiplier 1 (range 0.1–10). Cooldown defaults to zero, with a range of 0–600 seconds. Only a successful Last Stand rescue starts its cooldown; totems and failed attempts do
